sql_templates.description: Select VCP breakout stocks with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.name: vcp_breakouts
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT eod.symbol, eod.close, eod.high, snaps.enhanced_fund_score, vcp.vcp_score, vcp.vcp_breakout_pct
FROM market.equity_eod eod
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots snaps ON eod.symbol = snaps.symbol AND eod.trade_date = snaps.snapshot_date
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks vcp ON eod.symbol = vcp.symbol
WHERE eod.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
AND snaps.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND vcp.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
AND snaps.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
AND snaps.enhanced_fund_score > 80
ORDER BY vcp.vcp_score DESC, vcp.rank ASC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: Focus on freshness and identify gaps in fundamentals or volatility contraction patterns.
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0366
